book.name: Roma
book.title: Roma Paulo Malele Epapua Roma Taonina Kristiano Papiauꞌi Eeꞌiai Eulaisa Auga

content: Aau akiu Kristiano papiaumi, lau Israel papiauꞌi fauꞌiai alou koꞌagai anina laani, ke eꞌu megamega Deo eegai auga, Deo isa kaniaꞌi feagamauga laoma.
Gome isa aloꞌi koꞌagai Deo muninai kepea kai, Deo ega iifa koꞌa logo auga kainai akepea auga koꞌa mo laifafoua.
Gome Deo eegai alo opai laoga maina emai auga oko akelogo kai, ifoꞌi Deo maagai alo opai auꞌi fekemia auga keagaga kekapunia. Ega koa kekapaisa, Deo isa aloꞌi opaina fekemia eoma auga kainai akepea.
Gome Iesu Kristo auga, Moses ega iifa papiau Deo maagai alo opai auꞌi fepamiaꞌi eoma pinauga auga isa epafua. Ega koa kaisau mo isa kepakoꞌania auꞌi Deo maagai alo opai auꞌi fekemia eoma.

Lau ega laifa oma, gome Moses ega iifa pukagai ega iifa muninai kepea alo opai auꞌi kegamia keoma auga fouga iina eifa oma: “Kaisau iꞌina iifaꞌi maꞌoai agekapaꞌi auga, egaꞌina iifaꞌi kaiꞌiai ageagu,” eoma.

Kai pakoꞌa puogai Deo maagai alo opai auꞌi kemia auga fouga iina eifa oma: “Oi guami alogai foloifa foloinaka, ‘Kaisau ufai ageꞌagau?’ folooma. (Egaꞌina iifaga auga Iesu Kristo feake femai auga fouga eifania.)
“Ke oi guami alogai foloifa foloinaka, ‘Kaisau ageake agelao aꞌisa papagai ipauma?’
folooma. (Egaꞌina iifaga auga Iesu Kristo maeai femaunimue auga fouga eifania.)

Ega koa aisama, Moses Deo ega iifa pukagai kapaꞌina feifania eoma. Isa iina eifa oma: “Lopia ega iifa oi eemuai ekae; Egaꞌina iifaga oi akemuai, ke guamuai isafa ekae,” eoma. Egaꞌina iifaga pau aifafoua auga pakoꞌa fouga eifania.
Pakoꞌa iifaga egaꞌina auga oi akemiai Iesu Kristo Lopia auga agoifafoua, ke alomi koꞌagai Deo isa maeai epamaunimue auga agopakoꞌania aisama, Deo oi kaniami ageagamauga.
Gome oi alomi koꞌagai Iesu agopakoꞌania aisama, Deo maagai alo opai aumi agomia. Ke oi akemiai Iesu Kristo Lopia auga agoifafoua aisama, Deo oi kaniami ageagamauga.
Ega koa emia auga Deo ega iifa pukagai kepapua koa iꞌopoga mo emia: “Kaisau isa epakoꞌania auga, afaemeagai.”

Egaꞌina iifaga auga papiau maꞌoai mo fouꞌi eifania. Gome Iudea papiauꞌi ke Iudea papiauꞌi laaꞌi auꞌi fou epoꞌiai iꞌoina agaꞌo laaꞌi, Deo auga ifogamo isa maꞌoai eꞌi Lopia emia. Ke kaisau mo Isa aka keifaga auꞌi, kapa feloꞌi maꞌo agepeniꞌi.
Gome egaꞌina fouga Deo ega iifa pukagai iina eifa oma: “Papiau maꞌoai Lopia aka keifaga auꞌi, kaniaꞌi ageisagamau,” eoma.

Ega kainai papiau Lopia akepakoꞌania koa aisama, ala koa iꞌopoga Isa aka akeifaga? Ke Isa fouga aꞌo akelogonia koa aisama, ala koa iꞌopoga Isa akepakoꞌania agekaina? Ke kai agaꞌo Isa fouga afaeinogonia koa aisama, ala koa iꞌopoga Isa fouga akelogo?
Ke Deo isa afaeulaiꞌi koa aisama, ala koa iꞌopoga isa akeinogo agekaina? Ega kainai Deo ega iifa pukagai iina eifa oma: “Deo ega iifa faunina kepapea auꞌi auga ifeꞌi efelo alogaina,” eoma.

Kai profeta Aisaea Deo ega iifa pukagai iina eifa oma: “Lopia, kaisau iꞌa aꞌa iifa epakoꞌania?” eoma. Egaꞌina iifaga koa iꞌopoga, Israel papiauꞌi maꞌoai laaꞌi kai, isaꞌi mo iifa faunina Iesu fouga kainai kepea.
Ega mo ganinagai, papiau iifa aꞌo kelogo aisama, Iesu kepakoꞌania. Ke egaꞌina iifaga auga Iesu ega iifa faagagai emai.
Kai lau lapaꞌani. Israel papiauꞌi egaꞌina iifaga aꞌo akelogonia ma? Laaꞌi, isa egaꞌina iifaga aꞌo kelogonia. Egaꞌina fouga Deo ega iifa pukagai iina eifa oma:

content.text: “Lopia fouga iifafouga emia auga ainaꞌi elao agofaꞌa fofouga aꞌo kelogonia,
ke eꞌi iifa elao agofaꞌa fua eafiia,”

content: eoma. Sam 19:4
Kai lau lapaꞌani pugu. Israel papiauꞌi egaꞌina iifaga oko akelogo ma? Laaꞌi, oko kelogo efua. Gome Moses eufai Deo ega iifa iina eifa oma:

content.text: “Oi Lau eꞌu ago papiauꞌi laaꞌi auꞌi eeꞌiai fopikupa auga laoga maina alakapa.
Ke Lau oi ago agaꞌo papiauꞌi kapa agaꞌo akelogo auꞌi eeꞌiai guami fekupu auga laoga maina alakapa,”

content: eoma. Deuteronomy 32:21
Ke profeta Aisaea isafa aimaniꞌina mo Deo ega iifa iina eifa oma:

content.text: Ke papiau Lau afakepaꞌani ainiau auꞌi, Lau ifou isa alaapakina peniꞌi,”

content: eoma. Aisaea 65:1
Kai Deo Israel papiauꞌi eifaniꞌi auga fouga Aisaea iina eifa oma:
